meta.note: v2: direction D (white, juniper, lichen) designed on the Pebble Visual Directions canvas. Values are NOT in the repo yet; apps/web/src/styles/tokens.css still holds v1. v2.1: added library and learning-item components and the brand layer (imagery, editorial pages, seal).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Primitive. Pure white: the reading page, inset panels, keycaps.

tokens.name: rice-50
tokens.usage: Primitive. Rice-paper off-white: sidebar and player bar.

tokens.name: rice-100
tokens.usage: Primitive. Neutral fill for secondary buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: stone-200
tokens.usage: Primitive. Hairlines, progress track, hover on rice-100 fills.

tokens.name: stone-300
tokens.usage: Primitive. Keycap edge, dashed review outline.

tokens.name: stone-400
tokens.usage: Primitive. Control outlines: 3.8:1 on white, 3.2:1 on rice-100.

tokens.name: stone-500
tokens.usage: Primitive. Tertiary text (5.3:1 on white).

tokens.name: stone-600
tokens.usage: Primitive. Secondary text (7.3:1 on white).

tokens.name: sumi-900
tokens.usage: Primitive. Sumi ink: primary text and icons.

tokens.name: lichen-100
tokens.usage: Primitive. Pale lichen: current nav tab, count badge.

tokens.name: lichen-200
tokens.usage: Primitive. Lichen: current transcript line, toggles that are on.

tokens.name: juniper-400
tokens.usage: Primitive. Muted juniper for work in progress (processing bars). 4.1:1 on white, 3.1:1 against the stone-200 track.

tokens.name: juniper-600
tokens.usage: Primitive. Juniper green, the one brand hue (7.5:1 with white).

tokens.name: juniper-700
tokens.usage: Primitive. Pressed/hover juniper (derived: one step darker).

tokens.name: rust-50
tokens.usage: Primitive. Rust tint.

tokens.name: rust-200
tokens.usage: Primitive. Rust border.

tokens.name: rust-700
tokens.usage: Primitive. Oxidised iron red (7.7:1 with white).

tokens.name: rust-800
tokens.usage: Primitive. Pressed/hover rust (derived).

tokens.name: honey-50
tokens.usage: Primitive. Honey tint.

tokens.name: honey-200
tokens.usage: Primitive. Honey border.

tokens.name: honey-700
tokens.usage: Primitive. Honey amber (5.9:1 with white, 5.3:1 on honey-50).

tokens.name: bg-page
tokens.usage: The reading surface: transcript column and main content. → white

tokens.name: bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Chrome around the reading surface: sidebar and docked player. → rice-50

tokens.name: bg-muted
tokens.usage: Fill for secondary buttons, toggles that are off, inputs and the replay button. → rice-100

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill for anything resting on bg-muted. → stone-200

tokens.name: bg-selected
tokens.usage: Current navigation tab and count badges. → lichen-100

tokens.name: bg-active
tokens.usage: The current transcript line and toggles that are on (with ring-selected). → lichen-200

tokens.name: bg-inset
tokens.usage: Panels inside bg-active: the English translation, line action tiles. → white

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body text, headings, current and upcoming lines, icons. 14:1+ on every ground. → sumi-900

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text: Chinese subtitle, pinyin, nav labels, shortcut labels, helper text. 6:1+ on every ground. → stone-600

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Timestamps and past transcript lines. 5.3:1 on bg-page; use only on bg-page, bg-subtle and bg-inset. → stone-500

tokens.name: text-accent
tokens.usage: Links, the overline kicker, the current line's time. → juniper-600

tokens.name: text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent, error and accent-hover fills. → white

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action fill (Add audio, play/pause, line toggles on), progress fill, marker square, focus ring. → juniper-600

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill of accent buttons. → juniper-700

tokens.name: accent-pending
tokens.usage: Fill of a progress bar for work that isn't playback (an episode still processing). Non-text only; meets 3:1 against the track. → juniper-400

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines: sidebar edge, player top rule, dividers. → stone-200

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Decorative only: keycap edges, dashed review tags. 1.45:1, so never the only boundary of a control (use border-control). → stone-300

tokens.name: border-selected
tokens.usage: The inset ring on a selected toggle. → juniper-600

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of any control that has one (checkbox, an outlined input, a select without fill). Meets the 3:1 non-text minimum on every ground. border-default stays for decorative lines only. → stone-400

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px :focus-visible outline, offset 2px (5.3:1+ on every ground). → juniper-600

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error titles, inline error text, destructive buttons (white text), invalid-field ring. → rust-700

tokens.name: error-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill of destructive buttons. → rust-800

tokens.name: error-bg
tokens.usage: Background of error banners. → rust-50

tokens.name: error-border
tokens.usage: 1px ring around error banners. → rust-200

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning titles and icons, warning tag text. → honey-700

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Background of warning banners and tags (preview transcript, sample audio). → honey-50

tokens.name: warning-border
tokens.usage: 1px ring around warning banners. → honey-200

tokens.name: img-xuan
tokens.usage: Image layer only, never a UI fill. Xuan paper. Grounds of brand pages and image frames.

tokens.name: img-sumi
tokens.usage: Image layer only, never a UI fill. Sumi ink in imagery and vertical brand type.

tokens.name: img-water
tokens.usage: Image layer only, never a UI fill. Pale reflective water.

tokens.name: img-moss
tokens.usage: Image layer only, never a UI fill. Grass and moss in imagery.

tokens.name: img-leaf
tokens.usage: Image layer only, never a UI fill. Leaf green in imagery.

tokens.name: img-hair
tokens.usage: Image layer only, never a UI fill. White hair, snow, pale variegation.

tokens.name: img-slate
tokens.usage: Image layer only, never a UI fill. Cloth and shadow.

tokens.name: seal
tokens.usage: Brand mark. Vermilion of the 小石 seal (white text on it: 6.4:1). The seal is the only place this red appears; errors use rust.

families.zh: "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Noto Sans SC", "Microsoft YaHei", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display-lg
styles.sample: A Pebble on the Way Home
styles.usage: Page and episode titles. Huiwen Mincho has one weight: never bold it.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: The wordmark beside the logo; section titles on the Learning items page.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Chinese episode subtitle in text-secondary; card titles; nav glyphs like 书架 at 16px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: It's really round and smooth, and it feels cool in your hand.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Buttons, nav tabs, back link, banner text (400), pinyin (400, text-secondary).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Shortcut labels, playback speed, field labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Timestamps, counts, keycaps, tags. Always tabular-nums for numbers.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above titles and section labels (SHORTCUTS), in text-accent or text-secondary.

styles.name: speaker
styles.usage: Speaker letter before a transcript line, text-secondary.

styles.name: transcript-zh
styles.sample: 它很圆，很光滑，放在手里凉凉的。
styles.usage: Transcript lines and saved learning items. Set lang="zh-CN".

styles.name: pinyin
styles.sample: tā hěn yuán, hěn guāng huá
styles.usage: Pinyin under a line, text-secondary, lang="zh-Latn-pinyin". Generated by pinyin-pro, never by an LLM.

styles.name: vertical-title
styles.usage: Brand page titles set with writing-mode: vertical-rl, split by a 1.5px × 64px rule.

styles.name: vertical-body
styles.sample: 听一种语言，先要学会安静。
styles.usage: Vertical body text on brand pages; columns flow right to left.

styles.name: work-label
styles.usage: The 作品 label; its number is Work Sans italic 30px, with a 1px rule beneath.

styles.name: ruby
styles.usage: Pinyin above characters (<ruby>/<rt>) on brand pages and titles, text-secondary. From pinyin-pro.

tokens.name: space-half
tokens.usage: Hairline nudges: badge padding, keycap press.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between tabs, line-action tiles, transport buttons.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Default gap: button groups, title stack, key + label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Grid gaps in a transcript line; input padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Line horizontal padding (right), banner padding, button padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Line horizontal padding (left), sidebar inset.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Header bottom gap, player column gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Sidebar sections, top of main.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Large empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: The current-line marker square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Keycaps.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Nav tabs, line-action tiles, inputs, transport buttons, speed options.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Toggles and secondary buttons, the translation panel, banners.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The current transcript line, cards, sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Primary Add audio button, count badges, tags.

tokens.name: ring-selected
tokens.usage: Elevation stand-in: marks a toggle that is on (with bg-active).

tokens.name: ring-error
tokens.usage: Invalid input.

tokens.name: ring-thumb
tokens.usage: White ring around the pebble progress thumb, lifting it off the track.

tokens.name: edge-keycap
tokens.usage: Extra bottom edge on a keycap (with a 1px border-default border).

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: The only true shadow: floating word popovers (future spec). Everything docked stays flat.

tokens.name: shape-pebble
tokens.usage: border-radius of the play/pause button. Reserved for play only.

tokens.name: shape-pebble-small
tokens.usage: border-radius of the progress thumb.

tokens.name: border-width-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, banner rings, keycap sides, review tag (dashed).

tokens.name: border-width-selected
tokens.usage: ring-selected and ring-error width.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Focus outline width; offset is also 2px.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled or locked controls. Locked line actions stay focusable (aria-disabled).

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Fixed left navigation.

tokens.name: content-width
tokens.usage: Transcript column and the player's inner row.

tokens.name: player-height
tokens.usage: Docked player bar.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Toggle, secondary button, input height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary Add audio button.

tokens.name: line-action
tokens.usage: Line action tiles (ā, EN, save, edit).

tokens.name: transport
tokens.usage: Previous / replay / next buttons (touch target).

tokens.name: play-width
tokens.usage: Play/pause pebble width (height 60px).
